value: Early Alpha version for a https://mrdrnose.itch.io/votv-like game with animated giantess events made by https://x.com/HeavenlySize. Scan cosmic signals to witness various size events across the universe. Game contains a handful of animated events, and many reused commission images unlockable through a minigame.
Your giant boss Emi has tasked you with processing signals coming from outer space, in order to alert and lure giant girls to your planet.

Collect cosmic signal data and adjust dials to find the right frequencies and increase processing speed. Processed data can be viewed to reveal a giantess event or a celestial body. After randomly observing the same character a certain amount of times, they will appear on your planet temporarily. Send processed data into the mail chute to earn money and buy items.
